title: Seed Cells Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: P300 8-Channel Pipette (GEN2) will pick up tips.

steps.title: Configure robot parameters
steps.instruction: Select the P300‑Multi mount for the pipette and specify the number of destination plates to be processed.

steps.title: Process reservoir column 3
steps.instruction: Using a P300 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette, pick up tips, mix cells in column 3 of the 15 mL NEST 12‑Well Reservoir, transfer 250 µL to columns 1‑6 of the first SPL 96‑Well destination plate (Slot 1), then discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Pick up tips with P300 8‑Channel GEN2
Mix cells in column 3 of the 15 mL NEST 12‑Well Reservoir
Transfer 250 µL to columns 1‑6 of Destination Plate (Slot 1)
Drop used tips into waste bin

steps.title: Process reservoir column 4
steps.instruction: Using a fresh set of tips on the P300 8‑Channel GEN2 pipette, mix cells in column 4 of the 15 mL NEST 12‑Well Reservoir, transfer 250 µL to columns 7‑12 of the first SPL 96‑Well destination plate (Slot 1), then discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Pick up tips with P300 8‑Channel GEN2
Mix cells in column 4 of the 15 mL NEST 12‑Well Reservoir
Transfer 250 µL to columns 7‑12 of Destination Plate (Slot 1)
Drop used tips into waste bin

steps.title: Repeat for additional plates
steps.instruction: Repeat the column 3 and column 4 processing steps for each additional destination plate, using the next two columns of the reservoir for each plate.
